Name: talkohlooey-style Wizard Child NPC Portrait
Author: kragonaught
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url]. I hope I was able to do their style justice :') 

For [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]Portraiture[/url] only.
Made to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url], specifically if you're a darker farmer romancing the hot witch in the woods.

1. Download file and unzip.
2. Rename Wizard_Child.png file to your NPC child's name.
﻿Example: Sage.png
3.  Drag file to ...Mods -> Portraiture -> Portraits -> [Folder]

Might try to make more talkohlooey children if requested!
